Message:
They’re growing again...
I quickly plucked off
the new flower-like growths
sprouting on my arm.

These growths were
the same as the thing
stuck to my hand that day.

There’s been no end
to them growing back,
and it’s getting creepy.
Even the town doctor couldn’t
figure out what’s wrong with me.

The worst part was the way
everyone looked at me,
like I was some
kind of anomaly.

As piercing stares struck me
one after another,
I felt someone
squeeze my hand.

I looked up to see my friend,
smiling like usual.

My friend responded
with a grin...
only to suddenly
collapse on the spot.

Her face was scrunched
as if she were in
excruciating pain...
Then, something flashed
before my eyes—

Petals floated and
danced in the air.

Looking around,
I saw that every plant
surrounding me
was withering.

Why...? And as if
responding to my confusion,
the flower-like growths
sprouting on me writhed
and, all at once,
burst into a sickening bloom.
